_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 09: March 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Praying at a church for the youth, he says there is going to be a major revival among the younger generation, and that he has seen it specifically with college students.
mentions.quote: there is going to be a major revival with the with the younger generation
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival on American college campuses.

mentions.claim_text: He says doors will open for people in April like never before, from the beginning to the end of the month, and that private words have been given about April too.
mentions.quote: to open for people in the month of April like we've never seen before
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level: doors opening for an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says the next six months from April are a season of great acceleration with great doors opening for the body of Christ like never before, for those looking for him.
mentions.quote: of great acceleration for the next six months
mentions.condition_text: for the people who are looking for him
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration for the church across those six months.

mentions.claim_text: He calls a thirty day window of intercession up to 28 April for the Canadian election, praying the righteous rise up and vote and that there be no corruption in the process, that it be too big to rig.
mentions.quote: It's on April the 28th to pray for this window of opportunity
mentions.falsify_match: A conservative or righteous-vote outcome in the 28 April 2025 Canadian election, uncorrupted and decisive.
mentions.falsify_miss: The other outcome, or a close and contested one.

mentions.claim_text: A first person word promising greater works done through and with the hearer, walking side by side and marching as a great army under an impartation.
mentions.quote: be a greater work. And I and you'll work I will work through you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a promise with no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glory will come in a way never seen before to those who are simply yielded, and that God leaves the ninety nine to go after the one society gave up on.
mentions.quote: God's going to show up and show up
mentions.condition_text: for the ones who are yielded and saying yes
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He says people who were dead will get back up again and testify to what they saw, and that amazing things are coming in the days ahead, born out of prayer.
mentions.quote: you're going to see people that were dead that that will get back up again
mentions.falsify_match: A medically documented resurrection with a testimony attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the religious community and churches will not have them on their platforms but God sees them, so they will do it on YouTube instead.
mentions.quote: They may not want us to be at their platforms, but you do
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement about their own standing.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching from Gideon's three hundred who lapped, arguing God chose the undignified and thirsty who did not care how they looked.
mentions.quote: With the 300 men who lapped, I will deliver you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He describes his expectation in prayer that God will say something every time, and notes some of what is said stays private rather than going on air.
mentions.quote: whenever I'm praying I expect God to say something
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and relevant to the record: some of what he receives is deliberately never published.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for a move of the Lord and revival on the Senate and House floor, and for judges and members of Congress to make godly laws under a supernatural hand.
mentions.quote: move of the Lord on the Senate and the House floor
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival among members of Congress.

mentions.claim_text: A first person word: because of October he is giving extended time and a season of grace, a great wealth transfer will come on the one percent who are listening and they will be provided for, and there will be a great shaking to awaken over America because America will be humbled in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: a great wealth transfer will come on the ones that are listening, on the 1%
mentions.condition_text: the transfer is limited to the one percent who are listening and hearing
mentions.falsify_match: America undergoing a humbling shaking while a subset of believers prospers.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither, though the listening condition absorbs individual failures.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer covering Trump and Vance with their wives, children and grandchildren, that they make righteous decisions and bring forth the transfer of wealth.
mentions.quote: they're able to make righteous decisions
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: In spontaneous prayer he sees the word April flash, moves to July and back to April, and lands on Easter.
mentions.quote: I just saw April I saw the word April the month of April
mentions.falsify_match: Something of note in April 2025 around Easter.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing, though no content is attached to the month.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the word Sooners, says they were waiting for the land, and ties it again to the month of April.
mentions.quote: I see the word Sooners Sooners the Sooners
mentions.falsify_match: Something involving Oklahoma or a land rush in April 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing; the image is left uninterpreted.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that a new way of thinking and a new way of banking will be birthed, calls it a baby, and repeats the year 2025.
mentions.quote: a new way of banking a new way of thinking Oho will be birthed
mentions.falsify_match: A new banking framework launched in 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says being filled and controlled by the Holy Spirit means you will not miss what you are supposed to have, when, or how much, and mentions his son editing and memorising the videos.
mentions.quote: You won't miss it on what you're supposed to have
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on being controlled by the Spirit
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching with a condition that absorbs any miss.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer declaring divine increase and acceleration and that they will have the glory of the Lord in 2025, 2026 and 2027.
mentions.quote: We will have the glory of the Lord. 2025, 2025, 2026, 2027
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion for having the glory.

mentions.claim_text: He brings a prayer assignment to the watchmen over two judges facing demonic interference trying to sway a vote, and says three very bad judges will rise up to put roadblocks in the way.
mentions.quote: three judges that are very bad that will rise up to try to put roadblocks
mentions.falsify_match: Three judges obstructing an administration priority.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such pattern, though no names are given.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching that the Holy Spirit warns with sudden mental pictures of a family member, and that you should pray in the spirit over what you see even without knowing why.
mentions.quote: the Holy Spirit will come to us and warn us with pictures
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching about private impressions.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will not be treated this way and sees the intent of the heart, and reports hearing Isaiah 45 about hidden treasures and riches stored in secret places.
mentions.quote: I will give you Hidden Treasures riches stored in secret places
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scripture applied as a promise with no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: Continuing Isaiah 45, he says God strengthens even those who have not acknowledged him so that people from east to west know there is no other, and that money is never going to be your source.
mentions.quote: money is not ever going to be yo
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He declares 2025 a year the hearer will thrive with supernatural abundant supply, and notes an article saying the SEC wants to drop its case against XRP.
mentions.quote: the SEC saying that they want to drop the case against xrp
mentions.falsify_match: The SEC formally dropping the XRP case, which is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says as they keep digging he saw people burning papers and destroying computers, and that witnesses will come forward to expose the darkness they saw, including about January 6th.
mentions.quote: I saw them burning papers and and destroying computers
mentions.falsify_match: Whistleblowers coming forward over destroyed evidence relating to January 6th.

mentions.claim_text: Opening of a prayer session offering to touch and agree for whatever viewers need that day.
mentions.quote: we're going to touch and agree for everything you may need
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession.

mentions.claim_text: Teaching from Saul's blinding and healing after three days, arguing God had a plan for his life despite the evil he had done to Christians.
mentions.quote: Saul had an experience with the Lord shook him from the inside out
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: Reading news on vaccination, he says he knows what is coming and what they will push on people in the days ahead, and refers back to his warning about BlackRock and what he was seeing in the spirit.
mentions.quote: I warned you all about Black Rock and I told you what I was seeing
mentions.falsify_match: A vaccination push and a BlackRock development matching what he described.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither, though the content of the BlackRock warning is not restated here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not moved by what he sees or feels but by what the word of God says, and that if the word says it he believes it and that settles it.
mentions.quote: I'm not moved by what I see I'm not moved by what I feel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an epistemic stance that immunises the claims against contrary evidence.

mentions.claim_text: He says what is being believed for will come to pass if it lines up with the word, citing the wish that you prosper and be in health as your soul prospers.
mentions.quote: is going to come to pass if it lines up with the word of God
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on lining up with scripture
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the alignment condition absorbs any non-arrival.

mentions.claim_text: He prays in advance for a greater red wave in November 2026 with a larger majority and godly leaders, and calls crypto, the dinar, gold and other investments to go up in value.
mentions.quote: we will have a greater red wave in November of 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Republicans increase their majorities in the November 2026 midterms.

mentions.claim_text: He declares it time for the manifestation with no more hindrances, and calls a barrier breaker anointing that breaks the back of poverty and lack with a financial seed.
mentions.quote: The barrier breaker anointing is on us
mentions.condition_text: tied to sowing a financial seed
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private financial outcome with a giving condition.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him this is no different from praying over the election: people had free will to vote either way, and they still prayed every day in October right up to it.
mentions.quote: free will to to either vote for for Camila Harris or to vote for
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a rationale for why prayer and free will coexist.

mentions.claim_text: He urges stacking rocks as memorials of the times God has shown up, because people forget what he delivered them from yesterday.
mentions.quote: stack the Rocks every single Rock means something
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He warns single viewers that the Lord may be telling them today not to do this, that it matters who you link yourself to, and that the harder path may be their own choice.
mentions.quote: the Lord is warning you today don't do this listen to the voice
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: personal guidance.

mentions.claim_text: Testimony of a shock provision on 22 December when they thought they would have nothing, given by someone saying the Lord told them to.
mentions.quote: the Lord told us to give you this
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private household provision.

mentions.claim_text: He invites viewers to send a photo of an unsaved loved one so the family can agree in prayer for them, for healing or deliverance.
mentions.quote: you send us a photo we'll
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an invitation to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that in the next year and a half they will have a greater majority in the Senate and House, and that there will be a financial turnaround as soon as this Friday when a meeting is held.
mentions.quote: there will be a financial turn around even as of this Friday
mentions.time_phrase: this Friday, next year and a half
mentions.falsify_match: A financial turnaround dated to that week and larger congressional majorities by late 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He describes what he calls the beginning of the mark of the beast: something put into your brain that rewires it so you think differently, offered as rehabilitation for prisoners instead of a sentence of ten or twenty years depending on the felony.
mentions.quote: put this in your your brain and it causes your brain to be rewired
mentions.falsify_match: A neural implant programme offered to prisoners as an alternative to incarceration.

mentions.claim_text: He says people around the United States will demand their entitlements because government funding was cut off for a while due to how bad the seasons were, and repeats that he saw a plague and chicken shortages coming.
mentions.quote: people saying we want our entitlements because the government cut off
mentions.falsify_match: Federal food assistance suspended after crop failure, followed by protest.

mentions.claim_text: He says the warnings are to prepare rather than scare, lists food supplies and money shortages among them, and says the Lord provided a window because of October and the promise about his people who are called by his name.
mentions.quote: it's not to scare you it's just to prepare you
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the window framing again, with the October prayer as its cause.
